parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud network resource type used for traffic forwarding analysis. Valid values:

AccessInternetIpV4: all Alibaba Cloud public IPv4 addresses.
AccessInternetIpV4Limited: all Alibaba Cloud public IPv4 addresses subject to region-based throttling.
ElasticIP: elastic IP addresses (EIPs) (IPv4).
PublicIpEcs: static public IP addresses assigned to ECS instances (IPv4).
PublicIpClb: static public IP addresses assigned to CLB instances (IPv4).
NAT: Internet access traffic through SNAT.
TR: traffic flowing through Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) transit routers.
TRAttachment: traffic flowing through CEN network instances, including intra-region and inter-region connections. Intra-region connections have both inbound and outbound directions, while inter-region connections have only the outbound direction.
VBR: traffic flowing through virtual border routers (VBRs).
GA: traffic flowing through Global Accelerator (GA).
IntranetProbing: internal network quality probe data.
NisInspectionHistoryReportScore: inspection history scores
parameters.help_zh:
按流量转发所使用的阿里云网络资源类型进行分析，取值：

AccessInternetIpV4：所有阿里云公网类型IPv4。
AccessInternetIpV4Limited：所有受地域限速的阿里云公网类型IPv4。
ElasticIP：弹性公网EIP（IPv4）。
PublicIpEcs：绑定在ECS的固定公网IP（IPv4）。
PublicIpClb：绑定在CLB的固定公网IP（IPv4）。
NAT：通过SNAT的访问公网流量。
TR：流经云企业网转发路由器的流量。
TRAttachment：流经云企业网连接实例的流量，包括地域内连接和跨地域连接，地域内连接具备出入方向，跨地域连接仅具备出方向。
VBR：流经边界路由器的流量。
GA：流经全球加速的流量。
IntranetProbing：内网质量探测数据。
NisInspectionHistoryReportScore：巡检历史评分
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The metric name. Valid values:

bps: bits per second.
pps: packets per second.
rtt: the round-trip time (RTT) when a TCP connection is established.
RetransmitRate: the retransmission rate.
RatelimitDropPps: the packet drop rate due to throttling.
ActiveSessionCount: the number of concurrent sessions.
NewSessionPerSecond: the number of new sessions per second.
BandwidthUtilization: the bandwidth utilization.
passRate: the inspection pass rate.
If no RTT data is available within the selected time range, it is because the connection is a persistent connection and no initial connection was triggered during this period
parameters.help_zh:
指标名。取值：

bps：每秒比特数。
pps：每秒包数。
rtt：tcp协议建立连接时的往返延迟。
RetransmitRate：重传率。
RatelimitDropPps：限速丢包速率。
ActiveSessionCount：并发会话数。
NewSessionPerSecond：每秒新建会话数。
BandwidthUtilization：带宽利用率。
passRate：巡检通过率。
选定时间范围内RTT无数据，是因为该时间段里，此连接是长连接，没有触发首次建连

parameters.help_en: The start time in ms in the UNIX timestamp format. If this parameter is not specified, the data of the last hour is queried by default. The earliest start time can be 7 days ago
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间，单位ms，格式unix时间戳。未指定时默认查最近1小时。起始时间最早可选择7天前
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time in ms in the UNIX timestamp format. If this parameter is not specified, the data of the last hour is queried by default. If only BeginTime is specified, the data of one hour after BeginTime is queried. The maximum time span between the end time and the start time is 24 hours
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，单位ms，格式unix时间戳。未指定时默认查最近1小时。只指定了BeginTime时查BeginTime之后的一小时。结束时间距起始时间最多24小时
